description: Na₂Sc₂P₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.71 Å. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.20 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-36°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-34°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sc and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sc and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sc and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom.
